title: Mixing: Rock Show, Love In Song, You Gave Me The Answer, Magneto And Titanium Man, Letting Go by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

The first official mixing session for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars took place on 19 March 1975.

Paul McCartney and studio engineer Alan O’Duffy oversaw stereo mixes of five songs: ‘Rock Show’, ‘Love In Song’, ‘You Gave Me The Answer’, ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’, and ‘Letting Go’.

Six tape reels were filled, but only the mixes of ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’ and ‘Letting Go’ were used on the album.

Following the session, the McCartneys attended the US premiere of Ken Russell’s film Tommy at the Fox-Wilshere Theatre in Beverly Hills. They were interviewed by David Frost after the screening, before attending an after-party at Studio One at 652 N La Peer Drive, West Hollywood.
